prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A new 3D game art reference of a single imaginary cartoon kart accessory: a compact triple exhaust module. This is an obviously fictional nonfunctional toy prop, with chunky rounded shapes and no realistic internal mechanism. Exactly three large circular dark bowl-like openings sit side by side in a horizontal row on ONE shared squat cream-painted housing. Each opening has a rounded brass-colored rim. A dark gray inset face panel, three tiny orange decorative ridges along the back, and a small simple mounting tab beneath. All three openings point forward in parallel and are clearly visible and countable. Overall silhouette is short, low, and compact, about twice as wide as it is tall, with only a little depth. Polished whimsical cartoon platform-game aesthetic, sculpted rounded edges, subtle painterly wear. Almost-frontal three-quarter view revealing all three openings and a small amount of the side wall. One complete connected object, centered on pale gray seamless studio background, evenly lit. No vehicle, no flames, no smoke, no text, no scenery, no extra openings.
integration: One connected procedural triple-nozzle model per side, following the user-approved procedural replacement for Meshy. Each module faces outward; Square damages neighbours and never accelerates the firing kart.
